meta.name: Final Table
meta.description: The Table: K-Chef 2026 brings together Korea's top chefs to compete for the title of the country's best chef. Mysterious world-renowned chef Chris K., also known as Kang Han, Song-yi, who is fighting to save her restaurant, perfectionist star chef Woo-jin, and chefs with stories of their own face off in a fierce culinary battle. More than a competition, they find comfort in food and one another.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Free-spirited Chef Kang Han returns to Korea and visits Famiglia, where an encounter with its manager, Song-yi, leads to an unexpected commotion.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Han's dish leaves everyone in awe. With his departure imminent, Song-yi begs him to stay. Just then, news of a culinary competition catches his eye.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Kang Han enters The Table: K-Chef 2026 as Famiglia's head chef but needs new team members to compete. After forming a team, he faces top chefs.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Chefs put their creativity to the test with the puzzling theme "Island." Kang Han faces an unexpected hurdle before revealing his unique take.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: After the first round, Chairwoman Moon of Pyeongyeon Group visits Famiglia. Kang Han hides his emotions and cooks for her. Meanwhile, a crisis arises.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Kang Han begins to waver. Song-yi worries over his unusual behavior, but he hides his feelings. Meanwhile, another set of eyes digs into his past.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: While searching for clues before the next round, Kang Han and Song-yi uncover traces of the past that stir long-buried memories.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: An unexpected reunion shakes Kang Han. As he grows closer to Song-yi, a live competition sparks a shocking turn tied to his past.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Kang Han struggles to hide his distress after his past is exposed on live broadcast, while his presence stirs up trouble within Pyeongyeon Group.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: A sudden power outage plunges the kitchen into darkness, forcing Kang Han, Song-yi, and the other chefs to complete their dishes under great pressure.
